mechanism: Foscarnet can cause electrolyte abnormalities (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia) and renal impairment which may alter armodafinil metabolism and increase CNS stimulant effects; armodafinil may lower seizure threshold while foscarnet neurotoxicity increases seizure risk.
action: Monitor renal function and electrolytes regularly; assess for increased CNS stimulation or seizure activity; consider armodafinil dose reduction if renal function declines.
